kami_claims.help.countries.p1: A country owns land, collects plot tax and protects its citizens' builds. Founding one is free.
kami_claims.help.countries.p2: The president leads. The chancellor deputises and takes over after a long absence. Officers manage citizens and jobs.
kami_claims.help.jobs.p1: Jobs pay members for work on matching land, e.g. miners on mining land.
kami_claims.help.jobs.p2: Progress counts automatically. Meeting the quota in time pays the wage from the treasury.
kami_claims.help.land.p1: Each chunk has a type. The type sets the daily price and the protection rules.
kami_claims.help.land.p2: The first chunks are free, all others cost daily upkeep. New claims must border your land.
kami_claims.help.plots.p1: Citizens rent residential chunks as plots, pay a daily tax and decide who may build there.
kami_claims.help.plots.p2: Unpaid tax locks the tenant out, later the plot is lost. Plot law sets both deadlines.
kami_claims.help.protection.p1: Protection rules set who may break, place, use or open, per chunk type.
kami_claims.help.protection.p2: Borders appear when you are near them and whenever an action is blocked. Press B to change the border display.
kami_claims.help.provinces.p1: A province pays tribute to its overlord. The overlord manages its land, capital, tax, laws and jobs, never its treasury or members.
kami_claims.help.provinces.p2: A province can't leave on its own. It can request independence, which the overlord grants or declines.

kami_claims.help.treasury.p2: Days covered is how long the treasury lasts at current rates. Unpaid chunks go into debt and are lost after a few days.
